definitions.explanation: Installation, repair, or modification of electrical wiring and equipment in buildings — including power outlets, light fixtures, circuit breakers, air conditioners, and other fixed electrical systems. In Japan, most such work is legally restricted to licensed electricians ({電気工事士|でんきこうじし}).

examples.japanese: {電気工事|でんきこうじ}のため、{停電|ていでん}します。
examples.english: Power will be out due to electrical work.

examples.japanese: エアコンの{取|と}り{付|つ}けには{電気工事|でんきこうじ}が{必要|ひつよう}です。
examples.english: Installing an air conditioner requires electrical work.

examples.japanese: {無資格|むしかく}で{電気工事|でんきこうじ}を{行|おこな}うことは{法律|ほうりつ}で{禁|きん}じられている。
examples.english: Performing electrical work without a license is prohibited by law.

notes:
Composed of {電気|でんき} ("electricity") + {工事|こうじ} ("construction work"). Refers specifically to work on permanent electrical installations, not simple tasks like changing a light bulb or plugging in an appliance.

USAGE:
- Covers a wide range of jobs: adding outlets, rewiring a building, installing light fixtures, setting up home appliances that require hard-wiring (air conditioners, IH cooktops, bath-water heaters), and upgrading circuit breaker panels.
- Most {電気工事|でんきこうじ} in Japan is legally restricted to licensed electricians under the {電気工事士|でんきこうじし} {法|ほう} (Electricians' Act); unlicensed work can result in fines.
- In apartments and rental housing, tenants usually must get the landlord's permission before having any {電気工事|でんきこうじ} done.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電気工事|でんきこうじ}を{行|おこな}う / する: to perform electrical work
- {電気工事|でんきこうじ}を{依頼|いらい}する: to request electrical work
- {電気工事|でんきこうじ}{業者|ぎょうしゃ}: electrical contractor
- {電気工事|でんきこうじ}の{見積|みつも}り: electrical-work estimate/quote
- {電気工事|でんきこうじ}の{費用|ひよう}: cost of the electrical work
- {配線|はいせん}{工事|こうじ}: wiring work (a specific kind of {電気工事|でんきこうじ})

RELATED TERMS:
- {電気工事士|でんきこうじし}: licensed electrician
- {工事|こうじ}: construction work (general)
- {配線|はいせん}: wiring
- {停電|ていでん}: power outage
- {コンセント|こんせんと}: electrical outlet
- {ブレーカー|ぶれーかー}: circuit breaker
